description: Implement urn:ietf:params:jmap:did capability per draft-atwood-jmap-did-00. Binds each JMAP account to a Decentralized Identifier. Adds did, didDocumentUri, previousDid to account-level capability object. Defines DID-bearing property semantics (server-set, derived from binding, changes only on rotation). Handles DID lifecycle: rotation (with previousDid grace period), suspension (reject new creation, preserve existing objects), revocation (terminate sessions, orphan objects). Horizontal infrastructure — consuming specs opt in by declaring their DID-bearing types.
title: JMAP DID: account-to-DID identity binding
